fields.Name: T50 - Entity Form View Course
fields.Description: Verifies that a Course record opens into its full editable entity form with populated fields, confirming the form rendering pipeline works for the Courses entity.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer and open the 'Courses' entity from the entity tree. Click a course row in the grid (e.g. CHZ-101 Cheesemaking Fundamentals), then click the 'Open Full Record' button to load the full course form in a tab. Reach the state where the form is fully rendered with populated fields such as the course code, title, and level. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full Courses record form is displayed in a tab, not just the grid preview panel
Form fields show populated course data such as a code, title, and level value
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
